polls.description: China's advancement in domestic chipmaking technology, particularly DUV tools rivaling ASML, is disrupting global semiconductor markets and intensifying US-China tech competition.
polls.question: Is China's chipmaking breakthrough a threat or opportunity for global tech?

cluster_stories.title: China begins making homegrown DUV chipmaking tools: The Information
cluster_stories.summary: The machines are expected to be delivered this year to leading ‌Chinese chipmakers, ⁠including ⁠Semiconductor Manufacturing International Corp, Hua Hong Semiconductor and ChangXin Memory ​Technologies, the report said, citing people familiar with the matter.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BEGINS MASS-PRODUCING HOMEGROWN DUV CHIPMAKING TOOLS

cluster_stories.title: China DUV Chipmaking: How Machine Advances Could Reduce Reliance on ASML, Nvidia
cluster_stories.summary: China’s semiconductor industry may have achieved a breakthrough in building chipmaking machines that have long been dominated by the Netherlands’ ASML Holding NV. A state-backed firm in Shanghai has found a way to make so-called immersion deep ultraviolet lithography tools that are capable of manufacturing the most widely used chips, according to the Information.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA BREAKTHROUGH: State Firm Builds Chipmaking Machine Rivaling ASML

cluster_stories.title: ASML shares fell 6.5% after a report that China has started mass-producing DUV lithography tools
cluster_stories.summary: ASML shares fell as much as 6.5% in Amsterdam on Monday after The Information reported that a Shanghai-based company has begun mass-producing immersion deep ultraviolet lithography tools. The machines are the type that ASML has been restricted from selling to China under Dutch and US export controls. cluster_stories.headline: CHINA MASS-PRODUCES DUV CHIPS... ASML TANKS 6.5%

cluster_stories.title: China's chip tool push shows ASML caught in US-China squeeze
cluster_stories.summary: On the one hand, US controls on exports of high-tech ​goods to China are threatening to reduce access to a major market; and on the other, Beijing's push for technological independence in areas such as chip production raises the possibility of a China-based competitor.
cluster_stories.headline: ASML Caught in US-China Chip War Crossfire

cluster_stories.title: ASML Slides on Report of China Starting DUV Tool Production
cluster_stories.summary: ASML Holding NV shares slid to the lowest since early June after a report that a Chinese state-backed company has begun mass producing certain chipmaking machines, posing a potential threat to the Dutch firm’s sales.
cluster_stories.headline: CHINA STARTS DUV CHIPMAKING TOOL PRODUCTION... ASML Slides

cluster_stories.title: Nvidia behind $50 billion lease on Texas data center, FT reports
cluster_stories.summary: In an impressive move, Nvidia is reportedly set to lease Hut 8's data center in Texas, with the value of the arrangement potentially soaring to fifty billion dollars in the future. This state-of-the-art campus is designed to facilitate extensive artificial intelligence training and operations. Moreover, Nvidia is expected to sublease parts of the facility to its cloud computing allies, significantly advancing their AI infrastructure through the cutting-edge DSX architecture.
cluster_stories.headline: NVIDIA LOCKS $50 BILLION TEXAS DATA CENTER LEASE
